description: Opsco SK6812MINI-E — 3.5×3.5 mm addressable RGB LED, reverse-mount variant that illuminates through the PCB via a cut-out. WS2812 protocol-compatible. Common keyboard / wearable choice when you want light coming from the bottom side of the board.
name: sk6812mini-e
watch_out_for: Reverse-mount: requires a PCB cut-out under each LED so the light is visible from the back side. 5 V supply, WS2812 protocol (single-wire 800 kbps). For top-emitting in the same package, use SK6812MINI (without the -E suffix).
